name.description: What the agent calls itself, e.g. "Claude Code on my laptop".
The subdomain, instead of the random id.
name.patternDescription: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at most 40, not starting or ending with a dash

password.description: Asked for by the proxy as Basic auth, any user name.

port.description: The dev server's, on the machine running the command.

ttl.description: Seconds until the preview stops by itself; 8 hours when left out.

retryAfter.description: Seconds until trying again is worth it, as in the Retry-After header.

post.description: A token made by hand, for a script or an app the setup prompt doesn't fit. Shown once.

parameters.description: Matches name, id, collection or content type, case-insensitively.
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Matches name, id, collection or content type, case-insensitively.

post.description: Uploads files into a collection. The collection field must come before the files, and each file can be at most 100 MiB. When one file fails, none are kept.

get.description: Needs no sign-in: the random id is what makes a shared link unguessable.

patch.description: Files an artifact under another collection; its links stay the same.

post.description: Makes a preview `sloppa preview run` then connects its tunnel to, with the same credentials.

get.description: A WebSocket (subprotocol sloppa-tunnel.v1) carrying yamux, from `sloppa preview run` to the server, with the credentials that started the preview.

post.description: A link any number of agents can trade for a token of their own for 30 minutes, with the prompt that has them do it.
